summary: Koel is an open-source personal audio streaming server designed to let you host and listen to your own music collection through a web interface. It functions as a self-hosted alternative to commercial cloud-based music streaming services, giving you direct control over your local audio files. The project is licensed under the MIT licence and built with PHP.
goodFor: It is a good fit for users who want to access their personal local music library from anywhere without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: Maintaining a self-hosted audio streaming server requires managing your own media storage and ensuring your files are properly organised and tagged for the web interface.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server like Nginx or Apache, a database backend such as MySQL, and persistent storage mounted for your music files.
